text:
Below are four statements about isotopes of a certain element.
Which statement about the isotopes must be correct?
A
They are radioactive.
B
They are unstable.
C
They have the same number of neutrons.
D
They have the same number of protons.

options.label: C
options.text: They have the same number of neutrons.

options.label: D
options.text: They have the same number of protons.
